meta.title: About Us
meta.description: Learn how Gateway Door Systems delivers professional installation of secure doors, reinforced frames, commercial hardware, and access-control-ready openings for commercial, government, and sensitive facilities.

hero.title: Secure door installation for facilities where access must be controlled.
hero.description: Gateway Door Systems supports commercial, government, and sensitive facility projects with professional installation of secure doors, reinforced frames, commercial hardware, and access-control ready openings. Our work is focused, disciplined, and aligned with the needs of teams responsible for protected spaces.

images.overview: Secure door installation, reinforced security, and access control ready door solutions
images.reinforced: Reinforced high-security door hardware and locking system
images.access: Access card reader used at a secure commercial door

capabilities.title: We install the door systems that support secure spaces.
capabilities.description: SCIF and controlled-access environments depend on every opening performing as intended. Gateway Door Systems builds SCIF rooms and provides careful installation of doors, frames, hardware, seals, and access-control ready components used in secure facility openings.
capabilities.note: Project requirements can vary by facility, authority, and specification. Our role is to coordinate clearly, install precisely, and support the secure-door scope assigned to our team.

secureOpenings.title: Secure openings
secureOpenings.description: Installation support for secure-rated doors, frames, hinges, locks, seals, and related commercial hardware.

reinforcedAssemblies.title: Reinforced assemblies
reinforcedAssemblies.description: Door and frame installation focused on fit, alignment, durability, and dependable operation in high-use secure areas.

accessControl.title: Access-control ready
accessControl.description: Openings prepared for card readers, electric strikes, maglocks, closers, panic hardware, and integrated security systems.

trust.title: A careful partner for sensitive and controlled-access work.
trust.description: Government and facility teams need contractors who understand scope, scheduling, documentation, and professional conduct around sensitive environments. Gateway approaches secure door projects with clear communication and respect for site procedures.
trust.imageAlt: Row of secure commercial doors for controlled access environments

definedScope.title: Defined scope
definedScope.description: We keep the door, frame, and hardware scope clear so project teams understand responsibilities before work begins.

coordination.title: Site coordination
coordination.description: We work around facility access needs, project schedules, and the practical realities of occupied or restricted spaces.

documentation.title: Documentation support
documentation.description: We support clean communication around openings, installed hardware, product fit, and jobsite progress.

secureMindset.title: Security-minded work
secureMindset.description: We treat sensitive areas with discretion, professionalism, and attention to controlled access requirements.

process.title: A structured approach for secure door installation.
process.description: From retrofit work to new secure openings, our process is designed to reduce surprises and keep the installation aligned with the facility's requirements.

review.title: Review the opening
review.description: We evaluate the existing or planned opening, hardware needs, site conditions, and access-control requirements.

fit.title: Confirm the door and hardware fit
fit.description: We coordinate door, frame, seal, closer, lock, and access-control readiness before installation proceeds.

install.title: Install with precision
install.description: We focus on alignment, reinforcement, operation, and clean integration with the specified hardware package.

handoff.title: Support the handoff
handoff.description: We communicate completed work, installation notes, and any follow-up items needed for the project team.
